name: 코스모스
hint: Cosmos bipinnatus: flat 8-petal daisy-like flowers in pink/white/magenta, yellow center, very fine feathery thread-like leaves, slender stems

name: 튜립
hint: Tulip (Tulipa): cup-shaped 6-tepal flowers on single smooth stems, broad grey-green strap leaves

name: 쿠루쿠마
hint: Curcuma alismatifolia (Siam tulip): upright cone of pink papery bracts with green-tipped lower bracts on a tall bare stem, long paddle-shaped leaves

name: 석죽
hint: Dianthus chinensis / Sweet William type: small 5-petal flowers with fringed serrated petal edges, often bicolor with dark eye, clustered heads, narrow grass-like paired leaves

name: 백일홍
hint: Zinnia elegans: dense layered dahlia-like double flowers, bright but here muted orange/pink/red, oval rough leaves opposite, thick stems

name: 옥시페탈륨
hint: Oxypetalum coeruleum (blue star / tweedia): small 5-pointed star-shaped powder-blue flowers in clusters, soft fuzzy heart-shaped grey-green leaves

name: 메리골드
hint: Marigold (Tagetes erecta): round dense ruffled pompom heads in orange and yellow, finely divided pinnate dark green leaves

name: 천일홍
hint: Globe amaranth (Gomphrena globosa): small round clover-like papery globe flower heads in magenta/purple/white on thin stems, narrow oval leaves

name: 베로니카
hint: Veronica spicata (speedwell): slender upright tapering spikes densely packed with tiny violet-blue (or pink/white) florets, lance leaves

name: 스카비오사
hint: Scabiosa (pincushion flower): flat round lavender flower heads with frilly outer petals and pincushion-like dotted center, long wiry stems, also round spherical seed pods

name: 용담
hint: Gentiana (gentian): upright stems with deep blue/violet tubular bell flowers clustered at the nodes, narrow opposite lance leaves

name: 브바르디아
hint: Bouvardia: clusters of small 4-petal tubular star flowers in white/pale pink on top of stems, oval opposite leaves

name: 후록스
hint: Garden phlox (Phlox paniculata): dome-shaped clusters of many flat 5-petal flowers in pink/lilac/white with darker eye, opposite lance leaves

name: 부들레야
hint: Buddleja (butterfly bush): long arching cone-shaped panicles of tiny lilac/purple florets with orange eyes, long lance leaves with grey undersides

name: 아미초
hint: Ammi majus (bishop's flower / lace flower): flat white lacy umbels of tiny flowers on long thin stems, finely divided leaves

name: 아스그레피아스
hint: Asclepias (milkweed, florist type A. tuberosa / curassavica): flat-topped clusters of small orange-red and yellow star flowers with reflexed petals, narrow leaves

name: 층꽃
hint: Caryopteris incana (blue spiraea): whorls of small fluffy lavender-blue flowers stacked in tiers along the stem, grey-green toothed oval leaves

name: 등골나무
hint: Eupatorium (boneset/joe-pye): flat fuzzy clusters of tiny dusty-pink or white tubular florets, opposite toothed leaves

name: 루스커스
hint: Italian ruscus (Danae racemosa): long arching green stems with glossy narrow lance-shaped leaf-like cladodes alternating along the stem, no flowers

name: 멜라루카
hint: Melaleuca (paperbark / bottlebrush filler): woody stems with dense tiny needle-like leaves and small fluffy cream bottlebrush flower clusters

name: 비부리움
hint: Viburnum tinus (laurustinus) as sold by florists: woody stems with glossy dark green oval leaves in opposite pairs, flat-domed clusters of small white 5-petal flowers mixed with many round pink-red buds

name: 심포리카르포스
hint: Snowberry (Symphoricarpos albus) florist stems: thin reddish-brown arching twigs densely packed with clusters of round pure white berries (some pale green), small round blue-green leaves; berries are the main feature

name: 엽란
hint: Aspidistra elatior (cast iron plant): single large glossy dark green lance-shaped leaves on short stalks, no flowers
extra: 잎 위에 의미 없이 올려 둔 테이프는 넣지 않는다. 테이프는 잎자루나 종이를 고정하는 자리에만.

name: 쥐똥나무
hint: Variegated privet (Ligustrum sinense 'Variegatum') sold as foliage filler: thin upright reddish twigs lined with many small oval leaves edged in creamy pale yellow; NO flowers; only a few small black berries as a minor accent

name: 캐모마일
hint: Chamomile / Matricaria: many small daisies with white petals and domed yellow center, feathery finely divided leaves

name: 파니쿰
hint: Panicum (switchgrass): airy open sprays of tiny reddish-brown seeds on thin grass stems, narrow grass leaves

name: 편백
hint: Hinoki cypress (Chamaecyparis obtusa): flat fan-like sprays of scale-like green foliage with white Y-marks underneath

name: 도라지꽃
hint: Balloon flower (Platycodon grandiflorus): open 5-pointed star-shaped violet-blue (or white) flowers and puffy balloon-shaped buds, toothed oval leaves

name: 루드베키아
hint: Rudbeckia (black-eyed Susan): golden yellow daisies with dark brown domed center, hairy lance leaves

name: 사루비아
hint: Salvia (florist sage, e.g. Salvia farinacea): tall slender spikes of small violet-blue tubular flowers along the stem, narrow leaves

name: 솔리다고
hint: Solidago (goldenrod): plume-like branching sprays of tiny mustard-yellow florets, narrow lance leaves

name: 아스파라거스
hint: Asparagus fern (Asparagus setaceus / plumosus): flat feathery triangular fronds of very fine needle-like green foliage

name: 헬리옵시스
hint: Heliopsis (false sunflower): golden yellow semi-double daisies with yellow-orange center, toothed oval leaves

name: 꽃고추
hint: Ornamental pepper (Capsicum annuum): small upright glossy cone-shaped peppers in red, orange, purple, cream on leafy stems

name: 몬스테라
hint: Monstera deliciosa cut LEAF as sold by florists: one or two large glossy heart-shaped split leaves with holes on long stalks; leaves only, no flower spathe and no fruit (at most one tiny spadix, far smaller than the leaves)

name: 버들나무
hint: Curly willow (Salix matsudana 'Tortuosa') fresh-cut florist stems: bare twisted corkscrew-like pale green branches and thin curly twigs, absolutely no leaves, no catkins, no flowers, no berries

name: 개미취
hint: Aster tataricus: loose clusters of small pale lavender daisies with yellow centers on tall stems, long rough leaves

name: 연밥
hint: Dried lotus seed pod: flat-topped cone-shaped brown pod with round seed holes on a long stem

name: 조팝
hint: Spiraea (bridal wreath): long arching twigs densely covered with tiny white 5-petal flowers in small clusters, small leaves

name: 핑크뮬리
hint: Pink muhly grass (Muhlenbergia capillaris): cloud-like airy pink-purple feathery grass plumes on fine stems

name: 극락조화
hint: Bird of paradise (Strelitzia reginae): beak-like grey-green bract with orange and blue upright petals like a crested bird head, long stem, paddle leaves

name: 글로리오사
hint: Gloriosa lily: flowers with wavy reflexed petals red with yellow edges swept backward, long curving stamens, tendril-tipped leaves

name: 냉이초
hint: Thlaspi 'Green Bell' (pennycress filler): upright stems lined with small round flat green seed pods like tiny coins, small white flowers at tip

name: 산더소니아
hint: Sandersonia aurantiaca (Christmas bells): hanging orange lantern-shaped bell flowers along a slender stem, narrow leaves

name: 설유화
hint: Spiraea thunbergii: thin arching twigs covered with tiny white star flowers, very narrow willow-like leaves

name: 소철
hint: Sago palm (Cycas revoluta) cut LEAF: one or two long stiff feather-shaped fronds with many narrow glossy needle-like leaflets; leaf only, no cone, no fruit, no flower in the center

name: 솔리다스터
hint: x Solidaster: sprays of tiny pale yellow star-like daisies on branching stems, narrow leaves

name: 아네모네
hint: Anemone coronaria: poppy-like cup flowers with silky petals (white, red, purple) and a dark navy-black center ring of stamens, ruff of feathery leaves below

name: 영춘화
hint: Winter jasmine (Jasminum nudiflorum): arching bare green square-ish stems with small bright (muted) yellow 6-petal flowers

name: 오니소갈룸
hint: Ornithogalum thyrsoides (chincherinchee): dense conical spike of white star-shaped flowers with green centers on a bare stem

name: 폴리안테스
hint: Tuberose (Polianthes tuberosa): tall spike of waxy white tubular star flowers and buds, long narrow leaves at base

name: 셀륨
hint: Philodendron selloum (split-leaf philodendron) leaf: large deeply lobed and ruffled glossy green leaf on a long stalk

name: 시레네
hint: Silene (florist pink catchfly, light pink variety): many upright branching stems topped by dense rounded clusters of small pale blush-pink 5-petal star flowers with notched petals, with slim tubular green calyces between the flowers, oval opposite green leaves

name: 여우얼굴
hint: Fox face (Solanum mammosum): woody stem with glossy orange-yellow fruits shaped like a fox head with nipple-like bumps, leaves removed

name: 풍선초
hint: Balloon plant (Gomphocarpus physocarpus): round inflated pale green seed pods covered in soft bristles hanging from stems, narrow leaves
extra: 색연필이나 연필 스케치 느낌 금지. 다른 그림들처럼 사실적인 압화 질감과 입체감으로.

name: 피토스포륨
hint: Pittosporum (variegated, P. tenuifolium): dark twigs with small wavy-edged oval leaves, grey-green with cream margins

name: 광나무(여정목)
hint: Ligustrum japonicum (애정목) florist branches: yellow-green thin stems with fluffy airy panicles of tiny creamy white flowers, plus separate stems carrying clusters of small matte blue-black berries on yellowish branchlets, few glossy oval leaves

name: 꽈리
hint: Chinese lantern (Physalis alkekengi): papery orange lantern-shaped husks hanging along a stem

name: 스모그트리
hint: Smoke tree (Cotinus coggygria): fluffy smoky pinkish-purple hairy flower plumes and round leaves

name: 알피니아
hint: Red ginger (Alpinia purpurata): upright cone of waxy red bracts on a long stem with large banana-like leaves

name: 조
hint: Foxtail millet (Setaria italica): heavy nodding cylindrical bristly golden-green seed heads on grass stems

name: 홍가시
hint: Red tip photinia (Photinia x fraseri): branch with glossy oval leaves, new leaves bright copper-red at tips, older leaves green

name: 델피니움
hint: Delphinium as sold by florists, in vivid but soft clear blue / periwinkle / sky-blue / lavender-blue: mix of (a) mini delphinium (Delphinium belladonna type) with airy branching stems of open flat 5-petal flowers and rounded green buds, and (b) tall elatum delphinium with a dense column-like spike of open blue flowers with pale centers tapering to green buds; the blue color must read clearly

name: 아스틸베
hint: Astilbe: soft feathery plumes of tiny pink/white flowers, glossy fern-like divided leaves

name: 트리플륨
hint: Trifolium rubens 'white' (white clover filler): soft green stems with trifoliate clover leaves and elongated oval white-cream clover flower heads that nod slightly, cream fading to pale green

name: 돈나무
hint: Pittosporum tobira cut foliage branches as florists use them: woody stems with glossy thick leathery obovate dark green leaves arranged in whorled rosettes at each branch tip; no flowers, no fruit

name: 마가렛
hint: Marguerite daisy (Argyranthemum frutescens): white daisies with yellow center, finely divided grey-green leaves

name: 금사철
hint: Golden euonymus (Euonymus japonicus 'Aureomarginatus'): twig with glossy oval toothed leaves edged in golden yellow

name: 명자란
hint: Variegated Solomon's seal (Polygonatum odoratum 'Variegatum') foliage stems: arching dark reddish stems with alternate oval pointed leaves striped and edged with creamy lemon-white; leaves only

name: 상사화
hint: Lycoris squamigera (magic lily): umbel of pale pink trumpet lily-like flowers on a tall bare leafless stem

name: 에키네시아
hint: Echinacea (coneflower): pink-purple drooping petals around a large spiny orange-brown cone center

name: 에키놉스
hint: Echinops (globe thistle): perfectly spherical spiky steel-blue flower heads, thistle-like spiny leaves

name: 작살나무
hint: Callicarpa (beautyberry): arching twigs with tight clusters of glossy small purple berries at the leaf nodes

name: 연꽃
hint: Lotus flower (Nelumbo nucifera): large pink cup-shaped flower with broad petals and a yellow seed pod center, round umbrella leaf

name: 하이페리콤
hint: Hypericum berries (florist St John's wort): clusters of glossy oval berries (red, peach, green) with small pointed sepals, oval opposite leaves

name: 남천
hint: Nandina domestica: clusters of bright red round berries with fine compound leaves turning red

name: 아카시아
hint: Mimosa / Acacia dealbata: fluffy tiny round bright yellow pompom flowers in sprays with feathery silver-green bipinnate leaves

name: 헬레늄
hint: Helenium (sneezeweed): daisies with drooping notched petals in rust-red and yellow and a round brown center ball

name: 아게라덤
hint: Ageratum (floss flower): fluffy clusters of small powder-puff lavender-blue flowers, heart-shaped soft leaves

name: 아이리스
hint: Dutch iris: violet-blue flowers with three falls marked with a yellow blotch and upright standards, sword-like leaves

name: 억새풀
hint: Miscanthus (silver grass): feathery silvery-beige fan-shaped plumes on tall grass stems

name: 금어초
hint: Snapdragon (Antirrhinum majus): tall spikes of puffy two-lipped 'dragon mouth' flowers in soft pink/peach/white

name: 캄파눌라
hint: Campanula medium (Canterbury bells): upright stem with large bell-shaped lavender-blue or white flowers

name: 마타리
hint: Patrinia scabiosifolia: flat airy clusters of tiny yellow flowers on tall branching stems, pinnately divided leaves

name: 디디스커스
hint: Didiscus / Trachymene coerulea (blue lace flower): each stem ends in a single rounded DOME-shaped dense umbel of hundreds of tiny pale blue-lavender florets like a soft half-ball (not starburst, not fireworks), round green buds, thin smooth green stems

name: 리아트리스
hint: Liatris spicata (blazing star): tall dense fluffy purple spikes that bloom from the top down, grass-like leaves

name: 부추꽃
hint: Garlic chive flowers (Allium tuberosum): round loose umbels of small white star flowers on tall bare stems

name: 수선
hint: Narcissus / daffodil: flowers with six pale petals around a central trumpet cup, flat strap leaves

name: 케로네
hint: Chelone obliqua as sold by florists: upright green stems with opposite lance-shaped deeply serrated leaves; at the top a tight cluster of SMALL hooded pink tubular buds (each bud only slightly larger than a fingertip) surrounded by green bracts; buds are small and compact, not large flowers

name: 라넌큘러스
hint: Ranunculus asiaticus: round many-layered tissue-paper-like petals forming dense cupped balls, ferny leaves
extra: 꽃 색은 주황 대신 꽃집에서 흔한 연분홍, 크림 노랑, 살구 핑크 같은 부드러운 색으로 2~3가지 섞는다. 꽃 형태(겹겹이 둥근 종이 같은 꽃잎)는 그대로.

name: 천조초
hint: Larkspur (Consolida ajacis) as sold by florists: slender airy stems with fine feathery thread-like leaves and loose spikes of delicate ruffled flowers in soft pink, lavender-purple, and white, with many green buds at the tips; lighter and more delicate than delphinium

name: 히야신스
hint: Hyacinth: dense cylindrical spike of waxy star-shaped bell florets in blue/pink/white, thick fleshy stem, strap leaves

name: 심비디움
hint: Cymbidium orchid: arching spray of waxy orchid flowers with a spotted lip, long narrow strap leaves

name: 이끼시아
hint: Tritonia / crocosmia-like stems (이끼시아): thin arching wiry stems with a zigzag row of buds; some stems show open bright (muted) orange star-shaped 6-petal flowers, other stems show round brown seed pods lined up along the stem; mix both flowering and seed-pod stems

name: 덴파레
hint: Dendrobium phalaenopsis (덴파레) cut orchid stems as sold by florists: long thin arching green stems carrying 5~8 flat round orchid flowers (pink, magenta-wine, or pink-white bicolor) with a small rolled lip, and many slender green buds toward the tip; no leaves

name: 맥문동
hint: Liriope muscari: spikes of tiny violet bead-like flowers above clumps of grassy dark green leaves

name: 부들
hint: Cattail (Typha): tall stiff stems topped with a brown velvety cylindrical sausage-shaped seed head, long flat leaves

name: 부프리움
hint: Bupleurum rotundifolium 'Griffithii' (green filler): thin branching stems with round perfoliate grey-green leaves that the stem pierces through, topped by small star-shaped clusters of lime-yellow-green bracts with tiny yellow flowers; airy and light

name: 수수
hint: Sorghum: drooping clusters of round reddish-brown grains on a tall grass stalk

name: 유포로비아
hint: Euphorbia fulgens (scarlet plume): long arching stems lined with tiny orange-red flowers and narrow leaves

name: 토마토
hint: Ornamental tomato branch (화초토마토, Solanum ornamental fruit stem) as used in ikebana: long bare green stems carrying small round glossy red-orange fruits in pairs and small clusters along the stem, few small leaves; elegant line, fruits small like cherries

name: 까치밥
hint: Celastrus orbiculatus (oriental bittersweet, sold as 까치밥 branch): bare twisting brown woody branches with clusters of small round berries: yellow-orange split husks opening to reveal bright red-orange seeds; no leaves

name: 꽃양배추
hint: Ornamental kale (Brassica oleracea) cut stem as sold by florists: a rose-like rosette head with magenta-pink or cream-yellow ruffled center leaves and grey-green outer leaves, on a thick straight pale stem that shows bumpy scars where lower leaves were stripped off (like a stripped cabbage stalk)

name: 다정금
hint: Rhaphiolepis umbellata (Yeddo hawthorn) branch with fruit: reddish twigs with glossy leathery oval dark green leaves and clusters of round blue-black glossy berries on red stalks

name: 데이지
hint: Daisy (Bellis / Leucanthemum): white ray petals around a yellow center

name: 라이스플라워
hint: Rice flower (Ozothamnus diosmifolius) as sold by florists: woody stems with tiny needle-like leaves, topped by rounded dome-shaped dense clusters of tiny round tight cream-white buds like grains of rice (mostly unopened round buds, not open flowers)

name: 백야
hint: Ageratina altissima (white snakeroot, florist 백야): branching stems with opposite toothed heart-shaped leaves (some dark burgundy-tinged), topped by flat dense fluffy clusters of tiny bright white tufted flower heads at the branch ends

name: 속새
hint: Horsetail / scouring rush (Equisetum hyemale) as florists use it: a neat bundle of straight smooth hollow dark green stems with thin black-and-beige rings at the joints, clean and elegant, a few stems with small pointed cone tips; no leaves; arranged straight and tidy like a bundle of reeds

name: 싸리
hint: Bush clover (Lespedeza): arching thin branches with small trifoliate leaves and tiny pea-like pink-purple flowers

name: 아가판서스
hint: Agapanthus: large round umbel of many trumpet-shaped blue flowers on a tall bare stem

name: 아그로템마
hint: Agrostemma githago (corn cockle): single 5-petal pink-magenta flowers with dark lines and long pointed sepals on wiry stems

name: 에렌지움
hint: Eryngium (sea holly): spiky thistle-like cone heads surrounded by a ruff of spiny silver-blue bracts

name: 유도화
hint: Oleander (Nerium oleander): clusters of pink 5-petal pinwheel flowers with long narrow leathery leaves

name: 종려
hint: Palm leaf (Trachycarpus fortunei): fan-shaped pleated palm leaf on a long stalk

name: 치자
hint: Gardenia: creamy white waxy spiral double flowers with glossy dark green leaves

name: 팜파스
hint: Pampas grass (Cortaderia): large fluffy beige-cream feathery plumes on tall stems

name: 소재
hint: BUNDLE: a mixed bundle of florist foliage greens (eucalyptus, ruscus, fern, pittosporum) tied together, no showy flowers

name: 절화
hint: BUNDLE: a mixed bouquet of assorted cut flowers (rose, chrysanthemum, carnation, lisianthus, filler) tied together

name: 절지
hint: BUNDLE: a bundle of cut flowering and leafy branches (willow, spiraea, cherry blossom twigs, photinia) tied together

name: 열매
hint: BUNDLE: a bundle of berry branches (hypericum, snowberry, nandina, beautyberry, privet berries) tied together

name: 허브
hint: BUNDLE: a bundle of fresh herbs (rosemary, lavender, thyme, mint, sage) tied together

name: 그라스
hint: BUNDLE: a bundle of ornamental dried grasses (pampas, bunny tail, miscanthus, millet) tied together
